name: Fujiwara no Koretada
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 45); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 972.

poems.title: I dare not hope my lady-love
poems.author: Fujiwara no Koretada
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 45
poems.text:
I dare not hope my lady-love
Will smile on me again;
She knows no pity, and my life
I care not to retain,
Since all my prayers are vain.

poems.title: 45. 哀れとも いふべき人は おもほえで (Aware to mo iu beki hito wa omooede)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Koretada
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 拾遺集
poems.text:
哀れとも いふべき人は おもほえで
身のいたづらに なりぬべきかな
